summary: Iteration 233: Tested poll caching fix. All 6 features working correctly. Backend poll API returns correct vote counts computed from local votes map (test poll: 2 votes, try poll: 1 vote). fresh=true parameter bypasses cache. Both dict-based and list-based answer formats work. Frontend PollCard renders correct vote counts and percentages. Download page loads with Experimental Beta banner. Auth page shows Experimental Beta warning.
critical_code_review_comments: polls.py: get_poll_by_txid correctly computes vote counts from local votes mapping when on-chain data unavailable (lines 201-248). Handles both list-based and dict-based answer formats.
helpers.py: _CACHE_TTL_POLL=30 correctly sets short TTL for polls. p2fk_get skip_cache param works for fresh=true requests.
PollCard.js: 30s auto-refresh interval (line 47), post-vote fresh re-fetch with 3s delay (lines 119-128), correct vote count display with percentages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Poll caching fix verified. Backend uses local_cache fallback when p2fk.io returns empty for testnet polls. Vote counts are computed from local votes mapping. Test poll (54a00f...) has 2 votes, Try poll (af4bfb...) has 1 vote. PollCard auto-refreshes every 30s and re-fetches with fresh=true after voting.
